Quests allow you to explore new locations, meet new Dwellers and collect loot.

Build the Overseer's Office room to send teams of Dwellers from your Vault on Quests.

To access the Quest List, click the map icon from the Overseer's Office or from the Pip-Boy. The Quest List shows you your available Quests, their rewards, requirements and status. 

In Quests, explore the location by dragging Dwellers to new rooms, or just clicking on the room you want them to travel to.

Dwellers in combat fight automatically, but you can make them attack a specific enemy by clicking on a Dweller and then on the enemy. You can also click and hold on a Dweller, then drag the target that appears to the enemy.

As your Dwellers fight they will build up a Critical hit meter; once ready, a checkmark icon will appear over the enemy that your charged Dweller is attacking; clicking it will let you unleash a deadly Critical Hit attack. 

Click on the moving arrows that appear once they are in the center of the reticle, the closer the arrows are to the center, the higher the damage multiplier for your Critical Hit attack. 

The Critical Hit meters fills faster for higher Luck Dwellers and the Critical Hit arrows move slower the higher your Dweller Perception is.

You can see the mandatory and optional Quest objectives by clicking on the Map Icon in the top right corner.

When you're done exploring, click on the Map Icon to return the Quest team to the Vault.

You can use Junk and pay CAPS to craft items in the Weapon, Outfit and Theme Workshops.

COMMON, RARE and LEGENDARY Junk is found in Lunchboxes, in the Wasteland and on Quests, and produced by scrapping Weapons and Outfits. Rarer items require rarer Junk.

You also need an item's Recipe to craft it. Workshops start with some Recipes, but look for others on dead Raiders, in the Wasteland and on Quests.

Theme Recipes come in Fragments. Find these Fragments on Quests or use Nuka-Cola Quantum to complete your Theme Recipes.

Click on a Workshop's Craft button to see the items you can make there and select the one you want. Upgraded Weapon and Outfit Workshops can craft RARE and LEGENDARY items.

All your Junk is refunded if you cancel the crafting process after it's started, but only part of the CAPS you spent.
